name: pagination
source: Extracted from obs-table's footer (the Kendo .k-grid-pager). The product reuses the same pager outside the grid (e.g. _base-server-card.vue card view), which is why it is now a standalone DS element.
summary: The DS pagination footer as a standalone element — reusable under ANY paged view (table, card grid, list). Seek controls (first/prev · numbered SQUARES · next/last, Material-Symbols skip glyphs) + a page-size select + a 'start - end of N items' range, with a CENTERED slot for extra footer content (e.g. a severity legend).

variants.name: split
variants.what: DEFAULT — controls (pager + page-size) on the LEFT, item total on the RIGHT. Used when the center slot is empty.

variants.name: centered
variants.what: controls LEFT, slotted center content (e.g. a severity legend) CENTERED, item total RIGHT. Auto-selected by filling the default slot.

states.name: single-page
states.what: one page — all seek controls disabled, still shows the range + size select

total.note: total item count across all pages (drives totalPages + the range text).

page-size.note: items per page (the select's current value).

page-sizes.note: the size options (CSV string or array); the current size is merged in + sorted.

hide-range.note: hide the 'start - end of N items' text.

events.pagechange: detail = the new 1-based page number (emitted on any seek/number click and when the page-size changes → page resets to 1).
events.sizechange: detail = the new page size (emitted when the select changes).

slots.default: content CENTERED between the controls (left) and the range (right) — e.g. a severity legend. Filling it selects the CENTERED variant; empty = SPLIT.

decisionFlow: Paginating a table (obs-table)? -> it already composes obs-pagination in its footer; you don't add one yourself.
Paginating a NON-table paged view (card grid, tile list, custom list)? -> use <obs-pagination> directly: bind total/page/page-size and reslice your data on @pagechange / @sizechange.
Need a legend / summary in the middle of the footer? -> put it in the default slot (CENTERED variant); otherwise leave it empty (SPLIT variant).
Infinite/endless scroll instead of pages? -> don't use pagination; load-on-scroll is a different pattern.

split.useWhen: the footer only needs the pager and the item total (the common case).
split.dontUse: when you have a legend/summary to show mid-footer.
split.example: a plain data table or card list footer.

centered.useWhen: a legend or summary belongs in the footer center (product Monitors list — the severity legend).
centered.dontUse: when there's no center content (leave the slot empty for SPLIT).
centered.example: the Inventory > Monitors list page severity legend.

do: Reuse <obs-pagination> for any paged view outside the table (card/tile/list) instead of re-building a pager.
Drive it: bind total + page + page-size and reslice your data on @pagechange / @sizechange.
Put a footer legend/summary in the default slot to get the centered variant.
dont: Don't add an <obs-pagination> inside an <obs-table> — the table already composes one (use its `footer` slot for the center content).
Don't hand-roll seek arrows / numbered boxes — reuse this element so the Material-Symbols glyphs + square cells stay consistent.

a11y.summary: Seek controls carry title tooltips (First/Previous/Next/Last); disabled controls are dimmed and non-interactive. The page-size <select> is a native select (keyboard + screen-reader accessible); the visual caret is decorative (pointer-events:none).
issues: Numbered page cells are clickable spans — a keyboard user can't Tab to them yet (mouse/pointer only). Follow-up: role=button + tabindex + Enter/Space.

knownIssues: Page-number cells are not yet keyboard-focusable (pointer-only); the native size select IS keyboard-accessible.
related: select (the page-size control is a native styled select)
changelog: 2026-09-16 — The centered slot zone now keeps min 64px clearance on each side (padding:0 64px) so slotted content (e.g. a severity legend) never crowds the pager (left) or the range (right); min-width:0 lets that content SHRINK/collapse rather than push the pager/range off-screen.

2026-09-15 — Extracted <obs-pagination> as a standalone DS element from obs-table's footer, so any paged view (card grid, list) can reuse it (the product reuses its Kendo pager the same way). Carries the Material-Symbols seek glyphs, 28px square cells, the appearance:none page-size select with an obs-icon caret, the range text, and a centered default slot for a legend (SPLIT vs CENTERED variants). obs-table now composes it (total/page/page-size in, pagechange/sizechange out; its `footer` slot forwards into the center slot). No obs-table API change.
